summaryForNext: GATE SWEEP COMPLETE 2026-08-01 (H1 fixed, operator-directed): typecheck PASS (tsc -b, 0 errors), lint PASS (eslint ., 0 errors/warnings), unit tests PASS (vitest run, 32 files / 153 tests, all green), coverage FAIL — the single remaining red gate. This is a breadth gap, not a correctness problem — every existing test passes. Several 0% stores are Wave 2 retirement candidates, so coverage remediation MUST come after the Wave 2 store charter or tests get written for code about to be deleted. Top priority for analyze/plan remains: 187 unarchived OpenSpec changes exist and at least eight own this phase's goals (docs-storybook-visual-regression-perf-budget 26/30; screen-by-screen-validation 0/5; retire-a2ui-testing-page-from-prod 0/5; the migrate-*-page family resolves the Wave 2 goal that first looked vacuous) — inventory and reconcile before authoring any new change.
